name: rhvoice-web-bundle
description: Browser-side RHVoice WebAssembly bundle builder with administrator-managed voice selection.

scripts.build:sdk: vite build -c vite.sdk.worker.config.ts && vite build -c vite.sdk.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.sdk.json
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run prepare:site && npm run build:demo && npm run build:sdk
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:native && npm run prepare:site && npm run build:demo && playwright test
scripts.setup: npm run bootstrap:emsdk && npm run sync:rhvoice && npm run prepare:site && npm run build:native
